correctness.rationale: Finite topology implies Alexandrov because there are only finitely many distinct opens. The specialization topology therefore recovers the original topology. In the finite quotient poset, the union of maximal classes is open, dense, and contained in every dense open, giving the exact coherent-justification core. The chain count follows from the nested-tail lattice. Exhaustive checks on all preorders of size at most four and chain topologies through size ten agree.
